description: This file appears to be a Ruby script responsible for generating HTML documentation pages from XML source files related to a project called 'lighttpd2'. It contains classes for parsing various types of documentation XML files (module, chapter, angel module, index, all pages) and generating corresponding HTML documentation. It also includes the main execution logic for validating XML files, loading them, and producing the documentation output.

classes.name: Documentation
classes.description: Base class for generating HTML documentation from structured data, including methods to handle HTML structure, table of contents, and text formatting.

classes.name: GenericModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Represents generic module documentation, capable of parsing module XML structure and rendering related HTML components.

classes.name: ModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Extends GenericModuleDocumentation with specific parsing for actions, setups, options, and sections within a module.

classes.name: AngelModuleDocumentation
classes.description: Specialized module documentation for 'angel' modules, with custom parsing rules.

classes.name: ChapterDocumentation
classes.description: Handles documentation parsing for chapters, including sections and nested elements.

classes.name: ModuleIndex
classes.description: Builds an index page listing modules and related items; renders tables of modules, actions, setups, options.

classes.name: IndexPage
classes.description: Creates an index page with links to documentation pages and subpages.

classes.name: AllPage
classes.description: Generates a single HTML page combining all documentation pages.

methods.name: loadXML
methods.description: Loads and parses an XML file into a proper Documentation-derived object based on root node.
